```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(pbkrtest)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)

# Specify the path to your folder
folder_path <- "/Users/kyliealberts/Desktop/SLSI_data/SLSI3"

# List all CSV files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to check if a CSV file has a specific column
has_verification_code <- function(file_path) {
  # Read only the first row to check column names
  data <- read_csv(file_path, n_max = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Check if 'Finish.timesOff' column exists
  return("Finish.timesOff" %in% colnames(data))
}

# Initialize an empty dataframe to store all data
all_data <- tibble()

# Loop through files, load and append if it has the column
for(file_path in csv_files) {
  if(has_verification_code(file_path)) {
    # Load the CSV file
    data <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    if ("participant" %in% colnames(data)) {
      data$participant <- as.character(data$participant)
      data$bruinID.text <- as.character(data$bruinID.text)
    }

    # Append to the master dataframe
    all_data <- bind_rows(all_data, data)
  } else {
    cat("Skipping file, does not have 'Finish.timesOff' column:", file_path, "\n")
  }
}

```


```{r}
folder_path_o <- "/Users/kyliealberts/Desktop/SLSI_data/SLSI_O"

# List all CSV files
csv_files_o <- list.files(folder_path_o, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to check for required column
has_verification_code <- function(file_path_o) {
  tryCatch({
    data_o <- read_csv(file_path_o, n_max = 1, show_col_types = FALSE)
    return("Finish.timesOff" %in% colnames(data_o))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error reading file:", file_path_o, "\n", e$message, "\n")
    return(FALSE)
  })
}

# Initialize empty master dataframe
all_data_o <- tibble()

# Loop through files
for (i in seq_along(csv_files_o)) {
  file_path_o <- csv_files_o[i]
  
  if (has_verification_code(file_path_o)) {
    data_o <- tryCatch({
      read_csv(file_path_o, show_col_types = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Skipping file due to read error:", file_path_o, "\n", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    if (!is.null(data_o)) {
      # Assign a unique participant number (101, 102, etc.)
      participant_id <- 100 + i
      data_o$participant2 <- as.character(participant_id)

      # Harmonize column types even if some columns are missing
      data_o$bruinID.text <- as.character(data_o$bruinID.text)
      data_o$textboxAge.text <- as.character(data_o$textboxAge.text)
      data_o$textboxAge_2.text <- as.character(data_o$textboxAge_2.text)
      data_o$textboxBirthday.text <- as.character(data_o$textboxBirthday.text)
      data_o$textboxCountry.text <- as.character(data_o$textboxCountry.text)
      data_o$textboxQuestion2.text <- as.character(data_o$textboxQuestion2.text)
      data_o$textboxQuestion3.text <- as.character(data_o$textboxQuestion3.text)

      # Append to master dataframe
      all_data_o <- bind_rows(all_data_o, data_o)
    }
  } else {
    cat("Skipping file, does not have 'Finish.timesOff' column:", file_path_o, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
# Function to tag chunk number per participant
# Function to tag chunk number per participant

tag_chunks <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(participant) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      is_na_row = is.na(emails),
      chunk = cumsum(lag(is_na_row, default = FALSE)) + 1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-is_na_row)
}

df_tagged <- tag_chunks(all_data_small) 
```

```{r}
df_tagged <- df_tagged %>%
  dplyr::rename(Time = chunk)

df_tagged$Time <- ifelse(df_tagged$Time == 7, "Pre", df_tagged$Time)
df_tagged$Time <- ifelse(df_tagged$Time == 12, "Post", df_tagged$Time)
df_tagged$Time <- ifelse(df_tagged$Time == 15, "Post", df_tagged$Time)
df_tagged$Time <- ifelse(df_tagged$Time == 22, "Post", df_tagged$Time)

all_df <- na.omit(df_tagged)

all_df <- mutate(all_df, 
                    Response = if_else(str_detect(all_df$button_selections_1, "legit"), "legit","scam"))

write.csv(all_df, "SLSI_all_data_check.csv")
```

```{r}
all_df$SDT <- " "
all_df <- all_df %>%
  mutate(
    SDT = case_when(
      type == "scam"  & Response == "scam"  ~ "Hit",
      type == "scam"  & Response == "legit" ~ "Miss",
      type == "legit" & Response == "legit" ~ "Correct_R",
      type == "legit" & Response == "scam"  ~ "False_A",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
dprime_df <- all_df %>%
  dplyr::count(participant, Time, Study,agegroup, SDT) %>%  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SDT,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

dprime <- function(Hit, Miss, False_A, Correct_R) {
  signal_trials <- Hit + Miss
  noise_trials <- False_A + Correct_R
  
  hit_rate <- (Hit+ .5) / (signal_trials + 1)
  fa_rate  <- (False_A + .5) / (noise_trials + 1)
  
  qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate)
}

# Apply to each row
dprime_df <- dprime_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(d_prime = dprime(Hit, Miss, False_A, Correct_R)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#make different agegroups

all_data_o_age$Age_type <- " "
all_data_age_type <- all_data_o_age %>%
  mutate(
    Age_type = case_when(
      textboxAge.text <= 74  ~ "Youngest-Old",
      textboxAge.text > 84  ~ "Oldest-Old",
      TRUE ~ "Old-Old"
    )
  )

df1_updated <- all_df %>%
  select(-agegroup) %>%  # optional: drop old agegroup if present
  left_join(all_data_age_type, by = "participant")

df <- df1_updated %>%
  mutate(Age_type = if_else(is.na(Age_type), "Younger", Age_type))
```

```{r}
df$type <- as.factor(df$type)
df$Time <- as.factor(df$Time)
df$Study <- as.factor(df$Study)
df$Age_type <- as.factor(df$Age_type)
#write.csv(all_df, "all_df_SLSI.csv")

#accuracy
accuracy_model <- glmer(accurate ~confidence_scale_email.response*type*Time*Study + personal_rel_scale.response*Age_type + Age_type  + (1 | participant) + (1 | emails), data = df, family = binomial)

summary(accuracy_model)
```
